title: Case
description: An assistance case opened after a home visit.

urgency.description: LOW: Help can wait for the next regular visit; MEDIUM: Help is needed within a week; HIGH: Risk to safety or basic needs within 48 hours. Null when the input does not say; never guess.

Need.title: Need
Need.description: Something the household needs help with.

category.description: FOOD: Food parcels or supermarket vouchers; ENERGY_BILL: Help with gas or electricity bills, including disconnection notices; RENT: Help with rent arrears or bond. Null when the input does not say; never guess.
